dataset.name: ULB Credit Card Fraud Detection (Kaggle mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud)
dataset.source: Machine Learning Group, Université Libre de Bruxelles & Worldline; European cardholders, September 2013
dataset.citation: Dal Pozzolo, Caelen, Johnson, Bontempi. Calibrating Probability with Undersampling for Unbalanced Classification. IEEE CIDM 2015.

protocol.cv_description: Forward-chaining time-series CV on the training part (each fold trains on earlier transactions and validates on the next block)
protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler (and SMOTE) fitted inside each training fold
protocol.selection: Production XGBoost variant (incl. a small hyper-parameter grid) chosen by mean CV PR-AUC
protocol.threshold: Chosen on out-of-fold predictions; the holdout is never used for tuning

sanity_checks.note: A model trained on shuffled labels should score close to the prevalence. If it doesn't, something leaks.
